- [USER] User expressed interest in the major contributors to the development of psychoanalytic theory and their impact on psychology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Major contributors to psychoanalytic theory include Sigmund Freud, Carl Jung, Alfred Adler, Anna Freud, and Melanie Klein.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sigmund Freud is considered the father of psychoanalysis and laid the foundation for psychoanalytic theory, focusing on the conscious and unconscious mind, the id, ego, superego, Oedipus complex, and defense mechanisms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Carl Jung introduced the concepts of collective unconscious and archetypes and developed analytical psychology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Alfred Adler emphasized individual psychology and social factors, introducing the inferiority complex and the striving for superiority.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Anna Freud contributed to child psychology and developed the concept of defense mechanisms in children.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Melanie Klein developed object relations theory, focusing on relationships in personality development.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The impact of psychoanalytic theory on psychology includes influencing therapeutic techniques and leading to the development of disciplines like psychoanalytic therapy and psychoanalytic social theory.
